title: The Moon landings
examples: What year did the Apollo 11 mission happen?
Who were the astronauts who walked on the Moon?
What did the astronauts collect from the Moon?

explain.say: The Apollo 11 mission landed on the Moon in nineteen sixty nine.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin were the first men to walk on the Moon.

draw.text: Armstrong and Aldrin walked on Moon

explain.say: They explored the Moon's surface and planted an American flag.
The astronauts brought back important Moon rocks and soil samples.

draw.text: Brought back Moon rocks and soil

explain.say: In real life, scientists still study Moon rocks to learn about space.
A common mistake is thinking all astronauts walked together.

faq.q: Who was the very first person to walk on the Moon?
faq.a: Neil Armstrong was the first man to walk on the Moon. He took those famous first steps in nineteen sixty nine.
asks: Who walked on the Moon first?
What was the first Moon walker's name?

faq.q: What was the name of the mission that landed on the Moon?
faq.a: The mission was called Apollo 11. It was a very important space exploration event.
asks: What mission went to the Moon?
When did the Moon landing happen?

faq.q: What did the astronauts bring back to Earth?
faq.a: They brought back Moon rocks and soil samples. These help scientists learn about space.
asks: Did they bring back anything from the Moon?
What did they collect on the Moon?

faq.q: Did everyone on the Apollo 11 crew walk on the Moon?
faq.a: No, only Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the surface. Others stayed in orbit.
asks: Were there only two people on the Moon?
Did everyone go down to the surface?

faq.q: What was the purpose of the Apollo 11 mission?
faq.a: The main purpose was to prove that humans could travel to and safely operate on another celestial body.
asks: Why did they go to the Moon?
What was the goal of the trip?

facts: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in nineteen sixty nine.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the lunar surface.
The astronauts collected lunar rocks and soil samples.
The mission was a major achievement for space exploration.

quiz.say: The Apollo 11 mission landed on the Moon in:
quiz.why: This is the correct year for the Apollo 11 landing.

wrong.1: This year is too early for the successful landing.
wrong.2: This year is too late for the first landing.
wrong.3: The landing happened later than this decade.

quiz.say: Who were the two astronauts who walked on the Moon?
quiz.why: These two men were the ones who walked on the Moon's surface.

wrong.0: Armstrong was also part of the walking team.
wrong.1: Not every person on the mission walked on the surface.
wrong.3: Collins remained in orbit, he did not walk.

quiz.say: The rocks brought back from the Moon are used to study:
quiz.why: Moon rocks help scientists understand the Moon's history.

wrong.0: They are evidence of the past, not a plan for the future.
wrong.1: They show geology, not necessarily life forms.
wrong.3: While related, they specifically tell us about the Moon.
